children: DevvStream entered into a First Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement with EEME Energy SPV I and Southern Energy Renewables. For the $161,000 previously funded, EEME will retain 561,308 shares and 2,925,078 shares will be canceled. EEME will pay an additional $200,000 by Sep 29, 2026 for 1,120,448 new shares at $0.1785 per share (85% of the 15-day VWAP). The amendment also terminates all remaining funding obligations under the original $5 million facility; $1.64 million had already been advanced to Southern.
